Name: Simple Auto Play
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b]Simple Auto Play[/b]

Spend less time clicking and more time exploring. Simple Auto Play automatically performs selected actions on nearby targets using the tools you already own.
Press Alt + T to toggle automation, face your target, and let your farmer get to work. Choose which activities to automate through Generic Mod Config Menu.

[b]FEATURES[/b]

Mining
• Automatically break stones and ore nodes.
• Choose Disabled, Stones and ore, or Ore only.
• Ore only targets native metal ore nodes and skips ordinary rocks, gem nodes and large boulders.

Tree chopping
• Automatically chop mature, untapped trees and branches.
• Choose Disabled, Tree and stump, or Tree only leave stump.
• Young trees and fruit trees have separate permission settings, both off by default.

Combat
• Automatically face enemies within melee reach and swing repeatedly.
• Continue attacking until the enemy dies or moves out of reach.
• Uses your actual melee weapon. Does not chase enemies.

Artifact spots and containers
• Automatically hoe artifact and seed spots directly ahead.
• Break barrels and crates using a melee weapon.
Optional activities
• Clear weeds.
• Cut grass.
• Water dry tilled soil.
• Refill your watering can.
• Harvest ready crops.
• Pet farm animals.
• Milk and shear animals ready to collect.
• Collect completed machine products.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose your own activities
Mining, chopping, combat, artifact digging and barrel breaking are enabled by default. Other activities are optional. Auto Play itself starts off when loading a save and at the beginning of each day.

Automate while walking
Enable this option to perform selected activities while moving or holding a movement button. It is off by default. Normal tool animations may briefly stop your farmer during an action.

Play alongside automation
Stop on manual action is off by default. You can swing your weapon or perform another action yourself, and automation waits before continuing. Enable the setting if you prefer manual actions to switch Auto Play off.

Choose menu behaviour
Stop when opening menus is off by default. Opening a menu pauses actions, and closing it allows automation to resume. Enable this setting to turn automation off when opening a menu instead.

Adjust the pace
Set the repeat action cooldown from 0 to 1,000 milliseconds. Use 0 for no additional wait after an action finishes. Native tool animations and action completion still apply.

Set your limits
Configure an energy reserve and a stopping time. The default energy reserve is 20, and the default stopping time is 1:00 AM.

SIMPLE TOOL BELT SUPPORT
Simple Auto Play can use original tools stored in Simple Tool Belt, as well as tools in your backpack.
It temporarily selects the appropriate tool and restores your previous selection after the action. Manually changing your selection cancels restoration.
Holding an idle sword, fishing rod or ordinary item does not prevent automatic tool switching.

CONTROLS
Alt + T — Toggle Auto Play.
Both left and right Alt are supported. The binding can be changed through Generic Mod Config Menu, including assigning a controller binding.

REQUIREMENTS
• Stardew Valley 1.6.15.
• SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.

Optional:
• Generic Mod Config Menu — configure activities, controls and limits in-game.
• Simple Tool Belt — use tools stored inside your belt.

INSTALLATION
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract Simple Auto Play.[/*]
[*]Place the SimpleAutoPlay folder inside your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Configure your preferred activities and press Alt + T in-game.[/*]
[/list]When updating, replace the existing mod files and restart the game. Keep your config.json to retain your preferences.
Without Generic Mod Config Menu, settings can be changed in config.json while the game is closed.

LANGUAGES
Supports all 12 built-in game languages:
English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish and Hungarian.
The mod follows your game’s selected language.

IMPORTANT NOTES
• Your farmer does not automatically walk, navigate or chase targets.
• You need suitable tools and the required tool upgrades.
• Normal stamina costs, tool effects and game rewards apply.
• Automation protects unrelated crops, tapped trees and machines from its tool swings.
• Unsupported custom ore nodes are not automatically classified as metal ore.
• Compatibility with every mod combination is not guaranteed.

BUG REPORTS
Please include your SMAPI log, Simple Auto Play version, enabled activities and the steps needed to reproduce the issue.
For tool-switching problems, mention whether the tool was in your backpack or Simple Tool Belt.
